# elves_scim_group_rule (Resource)

Includes or excludes a rule for a SCIM group (for example an Okta group). It applies to every Mac whose primary user is an active member of the group, after the Mac's configuration rules and before SCIM user rules and rules set on the Mac itself. If a user's groups disagree on a rule, exclude wins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "elves_scim_group" "developers" {
  display_name = "Developers"
}

# Allow Docker for everyone in the Developers group
resource "elves_scim_group_rule" "developers_docker" {
  group_id = data.elves_scim_group.developers.id
  rule_id  = elves_rule.docker.id
  action   = "include"
}

# Don't apply a rule from the configuration to this group
resource "elves_scim_group_rule" "developers_no_block" {
  group_id = data.elves_scim_group.developers.id
  rule_id  = elves_rule.blocked_tool.id
  action   = "exclude"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) Required. ID of the SCIM group in Elves, for example `data.elves_scim_group.example.id`. Changing it replaces the assignment.
- `rule_id` (Number) Required. ID of the rule to assign, for example `elves_rule.example.id`. Changing it replaces the assignment.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Optional. `include` adds the rule. `exclude` takes it away when an earlier level adds it: rules are applied as default rules, then the configuration, then SCIM groups, then the SCIM user, then the Mac itself. Defaults to `include`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the assignment, `<group_id>/<rule_id>`. Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A group rule can be imported by specifying <group_id>/<rule_id>.
terraform import elves_scim_group_rule.example 12/68
```
